delta_summary.moral_floor: The moral floor was tested on multiple fronts this week, most severely on restraint and good faith, as the administration escalated past adverse court rulings on military deployment and used the shutdown to bypass Congress, though no verified event showed outright defiance of a final court order.
delta_summary.net_interpretation: Week 39 shows a government leaning harder against its own restraints across military, fiscal, prosecutorial, and press domains simultaneously, while courts, one military resignation, and several universities demonstrated that meaningful resistance remains possible. The standoff, not a single collapse or victory, defines the week.

long_synopsis: Week 39 unfolded amid a still-active government shutdown, with the administration testing executive power on many fronts at once. National Guard troops moved into Chicago, Portland, Memphis, and Washington despite court orders finding the justifications not credible; the administration appealed and threatened the Insurrection Act. Mass federal layoffs, diverted Pentagon funds, and withheld appropriations turned the shutdown into a political weapon. Congress barely functioned, with the House meeting only twelve of eighty prior days and a duly elected representative left unseated. Officials branded the planned No Kings protest as terrorism, reopened a prosecution against a prominent critic, and imposed press rules that drove nearly the entire Pentagon press corps into a walkout. Courts, a resigning admiral, and several universities pushed back. The Democracy Clock moved six seconds, reflecting a standoff rather than resolution.
short_synopsis: Troops deployed against court findings, a shutdown weaponized into layoffs and withheld funds, a critic reindicted, and the Pentagon press corps driven out — met by judicial resistance, one resignation, and university refusals. The clock barely moved: a standoff, not a resolution.

tagline: Courts said no. The administration appealed, escalated, or proceeded anyway. Six seconds of clock movement concealed a week of sustained pressure on every restraint.
